_doc: Level-1 control-plane / captain state. Point: EPIC. Location: <repo>/plans/fleet/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<epic>/state.json (relative to the project repo root, committed to that repo). Captain tracks the DAG-dependency tree + resume: computes the runnable-set (DAG whose dependsOn all passed AND not in failedDags), spawns fleet-orchestrator per-DAG + fleet-judge post-DAG. Pure DAG execution, no wave/barrier sync. Design ref: docs/design/2026-07-03-pi-parity-orchestration.mdx §4, ~/.pi/agent/docs/design/2026-07-03-fleet-dag-rework.md.
_instantiate: Planner (fleet Phase 1) fills runName/baseBranch/integrationBranch/branchStrategy/phases and dags[] (each DAG: dependsOn + failureTolerance + orchestratorModel + thinking + assignment safety-ratchet + needsDb/needsBrowser tags). Captain updates status/dagStatus/failedDags/stopFlag/knowledge/verification + per-DAG judge blocks at runtime. Strip every _doc/_example/_*-prefixed key before writing the instantiated file.
_status_doc: Step-0 resume glob matches plans/fleet/*/state.json with status:running. Kept from the Claude-only STATE.md status field, now living in L1 JSON instead of a separate markdown file.
_approved_doc: Set true at the Phase 2 Gate (single approval). Never set true by the planner.

branchStrategy._doc: Set ONCE at planning (auto-detect + one user confirm), used for the whole run. Resume anchor.
branchStrategy._trunkBased_doc: true -> integrationBranch ignored, captain merges DAG branches straight into baseBranch and pushes after each DAG passes.

phases._setupPreflight_doc: Phase 1.5 real-reflection preflight (SETUP.md, needsDb/needsBrowser probe). Kept from current Claude fleet.

verification._doc: Phase 1.5 output (kept Claude-only strength). Captain re-probes on every Build entry before dispatching DAGs that need it.

dags._dependsOn_doc: DAG-pure dependency (no wave/barrier). Runnable iff every dependsOn has dagStatus[dep].status === 'passed' AND none of dependsOn is in failedDags[].
dags._orchestratorModel_doc: Derived from failureTolerance: low -> opus, standard/trivial -> sonnet. Planner sets once; captain passes as explicit model override on spawn.
dags._thinking_doc: Per-DAG reasoning-effort default (high/medium/low), planner maps by complexity. Tasks may override.
dags._needsDb_needsBrowser_doc: Phase 1.5 tags, now per-DAG (were per-slice). Captain re-probes env supplies these before dispatching this DAG.

assignment._default_mapping: low -> implementer-critical + deep-reviewer ; standard -> implementer + reviewer ; trivial -> implementer-lite + reviewer
assignment._ratchet: Tier order implementer-lite < implementer < implementer-critical ; reviewer < deep-reviewer. Orchestrator may UPGRADE effective >= planned, never downgrade. Resume reads effective*, no re-judgment, no silent-downgrade.

judge._doc: Gate for this DAG. fleet-judge is always Opus, state-file-only, authority.
judge._attempt_doc: Bounded 2x. judge fail/needs-fix at attempt<2 -> orchestrator gets pinpoint feedback, one more attempt. attempt reaches 2 -> DAG failed.
judge._lastArtifactPointer_doc: Pointer into L2 state / commit the judge evaluated.

dagStatus._doc: Status per DAG (resume anchor). Recompute the runnable-set on every status change.

<dagId>._level2_doc: Pointer to the L2 orchestrator state file for this DAG.

_failedDags_doc: Captain scan: any DAG depending on an entry here cannot become runnable — mark it blocked-hard if it was pending. If no runnable DAG remains and nothing is running, fleet stops.
_knowledge_doc: Accumulated knowledge[] across DAGs (seedKnowledge + per-DAG knowledgeDelta). Reloaded on resume. Durable items also persisted to .claude/rules or .claude/skills.

stopFlag._doc: Captain stops the fleet when the runnable-set is empty AND nothing is running. Technical ambiguity never stops the fleet — the orchestrator decides and records an assumption instead.
